summary: In December 2145 at Epsilon Eridani, Bill watches Riker and Homer leave for Sol alongside a decoy vessel while he and his clone Garfield remain. Garfield joins Bill's project-list work, including improvements to VR and artificial muscle-fiber analogues for realistic robots or androids. Bill regards Garfield as a good partner and worries that Homer's cartoon avatar and incessant Doh's will strain Riker during the journey.

introducing.name: Garfield
introducing.current_state: At Epsilon Eridani, helping Bill begin research-and-development work while declining to participate in building Bobs.

introducing.name: Homer
introducing.current_state: Leaving Epsilon Eridani for Sol with Riker; he uses a cartoon avatar and incessant Doh's.

introducing.name: artificial muscle-fiber analogues
introducing.description: Artificial muscle-fiber analogues are under development for constructing realistic robots or androids.

updates.description: A virtual-reality interface Bob builds aboard Heaven-1 to provide sensory input and an embodied experience while he travels as a bodiless mind. It initially needs hardware modifications and remains an ongoing software project. Planned improvements are intended to support more direct interaction between users.
